name_reason: Renamed ch22_reinforcement -> ch22_sara_recruit. The '32' is the dispatch-table index (slot 0x32 @0x51C59). char 0x14 = 莎拉/Sara (龍騎士), a PERMANENT party recruit: the handler calls fd2_init_runtime_char_from_base_growth(0x14), which writes the shared menu-party roster and increments menu_party_member_count (permanent join), NOT an enemy reinforcement wave. 'recruit' matches the same mechanism in handler_3D (渥德); 'sara' is the established English form of 莎拉 used across the KB. Confirmed by ch22 walkthrough (莎拉 escapes the prison cell at turn 5 and joins).
purpose: Chapter-22 turn-5 recruit event handler: permanently recruits the joining ally char 0x14 (莎拉/Sara) into the menu-party roster with a portrait swap, camera pan, hold, and a joining dialog page.
logic_summary: Dispatched via the per-event handler table @0x51B91 at slot 0x32. Straight-line, no branches: __CHK(0x28) stack frame, then fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(2) (portrait set 2), fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(0x10,0x2A) (pan window to the spawn corner), fd2_wait_n_bios_ticks(8) (hold), fd2_init_runtime_char_from_base_growth(0x14) (instantiate the joining char from its base+growth tables), then fd2_display_dialog_scene(current_chapter_text, page=2, 0xA0000, 0x140, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, 1) (joining dialogue). In the binary the dialog call is reached via JMP 0x347F1 -- a Class-3 shared-tail borrow of the page=2 dialog body in fd2_chapter_event_handler_15 @0x347D9; the src emits the functionally-exact self-contained dialog call.

params.semantics: Dispatch-table ABI parameter (1-arg cdecl, void fn(uint event_arg)). This handler does not read it; the body is (void)event_arg and the only stack-frame use is the __CHK check. Kept as a parameter to match the uniform turn-event handler signature in the dispatch table.
params.reason: Name matches the established turn-event handler-table convention used by every sibling handler in chevt2.c; the arg is unused here (no address residue, no misleading name).
